moment_tension_strengths: Stronger concrete problem recognition and visual memory through the empty-chair scene.
More immediate emotional tension while still resolving into the Natal mechanism.
direct_offer_strengths: Stronger offer dominance and explicit visibility of the three supplied customer statuses.
Lower visual complexity, smaller delivery bytes, deterministic native media, and zero image-call cost.
moment_tension_risks: The photo competes with copy for attention and costs one model image call.
direct_offer_risks: Less emotionally distinctive and more likely to resemble a polished product-information card.

decision: Retain both as active, non-dominated competition strategies. Count candidate B as a controlled baseline, not as a generator-blind initial; use fresh isolated packets to build the strict five-candidate critic set.
